q_en: Which shortcut opens Windows Settings?
exp_en: Windows key + I opens the Settings app directly.
q_ja: Windows Settingsを開くShortcutはどれですか？
exp_ja: Windows key + IでSettings appを直接開きます。

q_en: Where are Windows 11 taskbar icons placed by default?
opts_en: At the top of the screen
exp_en: Windows 11 normally centers taskbar icons. They can be moved left with a safe setting.
q_ja: Windows 11のTaskbar iconはDefaultでどこにありますか？
exp_ja: Windows 11では通常Taskbar iconはCenterです。Safe settingでLeftへ変更できます。

q_en: What does Personalization mainly change?
exp_en: Personalization changes visual settings such as background, colors, themes, Start, taskbar, and lock screen.
q_ja: Personalizationは主に何を変更しますか？
exp_ja: PersonalizationはBackground、Color、Theme、Start、Taskbar、Lock screenなどのVisual settingを変更します。

q_en: Which path is used to change a Windows theme?
exp_en: Themes are found in Settings → Personalization → Themes.
q_ja: Windows Themeを変更するPathはどれですか？
exp_ja: ThemeはSettings → Personalization → Themesにあります。

q_en: What does a default app do?
exp_en: A default app is the program Windows normally uses to open a particular file type.
q_ja: Default appは何をしますか？
exp_ja: Default appはSpecific file typeを通常開くProgramです。

q_en: What information does Storage show?
exp_en: Storage shows how disk space is used and how much free space remains.
q_ja: Storageは何を表示しますか？
exp_ja: StorageはDisk spaceの使用量と残りのFree spaceを表示します。

q_en: Why is Windows Update important?
opts_en: It helps keep Windows safer and more stable
It changes the desktop picture every day
exp_en: Windows Update provides security fixes, bug fixes, and other system improvements.
q_ja: Windows Updateが重要なのはなぜですか？
opts_ja: 毎日Desktop pictureを変更するため
すべてのProgramをFreeにするため
exp_ja: Windows UpdateはSecurity fix、Bug fix、System improvementを提供します。

q_en: What is virtual memory or the page file?
opts_en: Disk space used as emergency memory
exp_en: When RAM is full, Windows can use part of the disk as emergency memory. This advanced setting should usually not be changed by students.
q_ja: Virtual memoryまたはPage fileとは何ですか？
exp_ja: RAMがFullの時、WindowsはDiskの一部をEmergency memoryとして使えます。Studentは通常このAdvanced settingを変更しません。

q_en: What are Startup Apps?
opts_en: Programs that can run automatically when Windows starts
Programs stored only on USB drives
exp_en: Startup Apps can launch automatically when Windows starts. Too many can slow startup.
q_ja: Startup Appsとは何ですか？
opts_ja: Windows start時に自動でRunできるProgram
exp_ja: Startup AppsはWindows start時に自動でLaunchできます。多すぎるとStartupが遅くなることがあります。

q_en: Which item belongs to the Danger Zone?
exp_en: Registry is an advanced system area. Incorrect changes can damage Windows settings or prevent normal operation.
q_ja: Danger Zoneに入るItemはどれですか？
exp_ja: RegistryはAdvanced system areaです。Incorrect changeでWindows settingやNormal operationを壊す可能性があります。

q_en: A student wants Windows 11 to feel more like older Windows. Which safe change is best?
opts_en: Move taskbar icons to the left
exp_en: Moving taskbar icons left is a normal Personalization setting. The other choices are advanced and risky.
q_ja: Windows 11をOld Windowsのように感じさせたいです。Best safe changeはどれですか？
exp_ja: Taskbar iconをLeftへ移動するのはNormal Personalization settingです。他はAdvancedでRiskyです。

q_en: Text and buttons are too small on a laptop screen. What should the student check first?
exp_en: Display Scale changes the size of text and interface items without changing the actual files.
q_ja: Laptop screenでTextとButtonが小さすぎます。最初に何を確認しますか？
exp_ja: Display ScaleはActual fileを変えずにTextやInterface itemのSizeを変更します。

q_en: A .txt file opens in the wrong program. What is the safest solution?
opts_en: Use Open with or change the default app
exp_en: Open with lets the student choose another program. A suitable program can then be set as the default app.
q_ja: .txt fileがWrong programで開きます。最もSafeなSolutionはどれですか？
opts_ja: Open withを使う、またはDefault appを変更する
exp_ja: Open withで別Programを選べます。その後Suitable programをDefault appに設定できます。

q_en: A student sees an unknown program in Startup Apps. What should the student do?
opts_en: Leave it unchanged and ask for help
exp_en: An unknown startup item may be important. Students should not disable or remove it without understanding its purpose.
q_ja: Startup AppsにUnknown programがあります。Studentはどうしますか？
exp_ja: Unknown startup itemはImportantな可能性があります。Purposeを理解せずDisableやRemoveしてはいけません。

q_en: Drive C: has very little free space. What is the best first action?
opts_en: Open Storage and check what uses the space
exp_en: First inspect Storage. Check categories and temporary files before deleting anything. Never delete random system folders.
q_ja: Drive C:のFree spaceがとても少ないです。Best first actionはどれですか？
opts_ja: Storageを開き、何がSpaceを使っているか確認する
exp_ja: 最初にStorageを確認します。Delete前にCategoryやTemporary fileをCheckし、Random system folderは削除しません。

q_en: A student wants to use a class picture as the desktop background. Where should the student go?
exp_en: Desktop wallpaper is changed in Settings → Personalization → Background.
q_ja: Class pictureをDesktop backgroundにしたいです。どこへ行きますか？
exp_ja: Desktop wallpaperはSettings → Personalization → Backgroundで変更します。

q_en: A school program appears in Installed Apps, but the student does not recognize it. What is the correct action?
opts_en: Do not remove it; ask the teacher or administrator
exp_en: Installed Apps includes important school and system software. Unknown programs should not be removed without permission.
q_ja: Installed AppsにSchool programがありますが、Studentは知りません。Correct actionはどれですか？
exp_ja: Installed AppsにはImportant school softwareやSystem softwareがあります。PermissionなしでUnknown programをRemoveしません。

q_en: A student cannot type normal English letters because the input mode is wrong. Which setting should be checked?
exp_en: Keyboard and Language settings control English, Japanese, and other input methods. The correct input mode is important for names and passwords.
q_ja: Input modeがWrongでNormal English letterを入力できません。どのSettingを確認しますか？
exp_ja: Keyboard and Language settingはEnglish、JapaneseなどのInput methodを管理します。NameやPasswordにはCorrect input modeが重要です。

q_en: A video says changing the page file will make every computer faster. What should a student do?
opts_en: Leave the setting unchanged and ask for help
Set the page file to zero
Open Registry and change more values
exp_en: Virtual memory is an advanced setting. Advice from a random video may not fit the school computer, so students should not change it.
q_ja: Videoが「Page fileを変更するとすべてのComputerがFastになる」と言っています。Studentはどうしますか？
opts_ja: Registryを開きMore valueを変更する
exp_ja: Virtual memoryはAdvanced settingです。Random videoのAdviceはSchool computerに合わない可能性があるため変更しません。

q_en: Which item is a correct example to write as a Danger Zone setting in settings_report.txt?
exp_en: Registry is a Danger Zone example. Wallpaper, taskbar alignment, and dark mode are normal safe Personalization settings.
q_ja: settings_report.txtにDanger Zone settingのExampleとして書けるItemはどれですか？
exp_ja: RegistryはDanger ZoneのExampleです。Wallpaper、Taskbar alignment、Dark modeはNormal safe Personalization settingです。
